# H038 — The knowledge score separates the 404 symptom-nominated target genes from the 396 matched decoy genes.

## The claim

The knowledge score separates the 404 symptom-nominated target genes from the 396 matched decoy genes.

**Prediction if true.** The target-versus-decoy AUC of the knowledge score, with a bootstrap interval computed the same way step 4 computed its own, has an interval that excludes 0.5.

**What would refute it.** The bootstrap interval covers 0.5. The knowledge route then has no measured discriminating power and enters step 6 as a confirmation route at weight zero, exactly as the read route did when H020 was refuted.

| 91 | neutral | 0.55 | measurement | The published-allele column shows 250 targets against 254 decoys - no difference - so all of the separation comes from the matched-term count and none from the saturated literature column. | `methodology/105` |
